steps.label: Re-verify live
steps.description: Re-checks the saved owner models. Does not retrain.

steps.label: Retrain with a new seed
steps.confirm: Creates a NEW owner seed and key. Every other result (B-E) becomes stale and E3's precomputed proofs must be re-run (~3 min, ~10 GB temporary disk). Continue?
steps.description: Starts over with a new owner key.

steps.label: Run forgery live
steps.description: Counterfeit-key forgery and ZKROWNN relation check.

steps.label: Run E1 + E2 live
steps.description: EZKL proofs without commitment (owner, thief) and the VK cross-check.

steps.label: Re-run E3
steps.confirm: Re-run the Poseidon-committed proofs? ~3 minutes and a ~10 GB temporary proving key per proof.
steps.description: EZKL proofs with a Poseidon commitment to the private parameters.

steps.label: Run demo F live
steps.description: Protocol v2 end to end: registration, Groth16 proof, verifier checks, thief, misuse, attacks and the overwrite dispute.

steps.label: Run all live
steps.description: evaluate, attacks, forgery, committed, zk (E3 stays precomputed).

steps.label: Verify this proof live
steps.description: Runs every verifier check on demo F's saved proof, including the Groth16 verification.

steps.label: Replay it for another claim
steps.description: Resubmits the saved proof for a new claim with a fresh nonce.

steps.label: Check it against a different model
steps.description: Checks the saved proof against clean.pt instead of the watermarked model.

steps.label: Tamper with the proof
steps.description: Changes one number inside the proof, then verifies it.

steps.label: Use an untrusted registry
steps.description: Backs the registration with a receipt from a registry the verifier doesn't trust.

steps.label: Test this model
steps.description: Reads the watermark in the selected model, measures its accuracy and, if the owner's mark is there, makes and verifies a Groth16 proof of ownership. Needs a model (GET /api/models).
